system.name: MOTION DX
system.tagline: Objective movement measurement using computer vision.
system.clinical_safety_notice: MOTION DX provides movement measurements and kinematics observations for clinical review and research. It does NOT make medical diagnoses or replace clinical judgement.

knee.literature_reference_note: Literature values for adult active knee flexion typically range ~130°-145°, extension ~0°. Actual functional ROM varies by age, sex, and individual anatomy. Displayed solely for clinical reference.

elbow.literature_reference_note: Literature values for adult active elbow flexion typically range ~140°-150°, extension ~0°. Displayed solely for clinical reference.

shoulder.literature_reference_note: Literature values for shoulder abduction / elevation typically range up to 160°-180°. Displayed solely for clinical reference.

steps.name: Neutral Baseline
steps.prompt: Relax face in neutral posture. Calibrates midline and resting aperture.

steps.name: Maximum Opening
steps.prompt: Slowly open mouth to comfortable maximum active opening.

steps.name: Closing Return
steps.prompt: Close mouth smoothly back to resting dental contact.

steps.name: Left Lateral Excursion
steps.prompt: Move lower jaw gently to the subject's left side.

steps.name: Right Lateral Excursion
steps.prompt: Move lower jaw gently to the subject's right side.

tmd.literature_reference_note: Adult active maximum incisal opening typically spans ~35-55 mm in clinical literature, lateral movement ~7-10 mm. Observations reflect physical landmark displacement.

gait.literature_reference_note: Observation of bilateral lower-limb sagittal kinematics, step frequency, and bilateral swing symmetry. Descriptive kinematic data only.
